description: Authored printed PCB carrier with optional removable bridge locks and configured anti-flex support features.
releaseRequirements: Measure actual PCB outlines and thickness; reserve outer-corner and bridge contact lands free of components, solder and exposed conductors.
Match optional side rails and underside support ribs to verified clear contact areas on the populated boards.
Check board, bridge, tool and host enclosure insertion/removal paths, connector mating and cable clearance.
Specify polymer, process, build orientation, attachment hardware and actual working loads; qualify fit, support stiffness, creep, vibration and service cycles.
